Jora Ward reacts with practiced, brutal efficiency. She instantly tightens the clamps around the aperture while simultaneously cycling the localized gravity dampeners to maximum power, attempting to physically stabilize the wildly oscillating energy field. The Entity, now fully energized by the dampener's frequency, initiates a final, massive informational broadcast—a deluge of pure data aimed not at the hardware, but directly at biological systems. The noise is deafening; it bypasses the speakers and assaults your inner ear like high-voltage static. Ren stumbles back from her console, hands flying to her temples.
